name: KDE 1 (Demo)
tagline: Linux's first cohesive desktop, in cool understated tones.
description: KDE 1 gave Linux users a unified graphical environment for the first time. Its calm teal and blue palette struck a professional tone that helped legitimize the Linux desktop in the eyes of newcomers.
